_meta.description: Heart event #4 for npc_michelle: The Breakdown

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Michelle's home. She's sitting on the floor, surrounded by herb bundles]

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Jack? I — sorry. I'm fine. I'm always fine.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Everyone needs something. Doc Bramble needs help. Pip needs bandages.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: The militia needs medicine. Maren needs visits. Everyone needs.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: And I give and I give and I give and nobody ever asks if I'M okay.

options.text: You don't have to carry everyone. Not alone.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I'm tired, Jack. I'm so tired of being the strong one.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: My parents died and the town healer took me in and I just... started helping.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I never stopped. I don't know HOW to stop.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: ...Thank you for sitting here. On my floor. Among my herbs.
